description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Business Configuration API within the Apache Fineract project. It tests endpoints related to retrieving and updating business step configurations linked to specific jobs in the system.

classes.name: BusinessConfigurationApiTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for integration testing the Business Configuration API endpoints, specifically the retrieval and update of business step configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured configuration and request/response specifications before each test.

methods.name: shouldReturnApplyChargeToOverdueLoanStepConfig
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns the configuration for the 'APPLY_CHARGE_TO_OVERDUE_LOANS' step when queried by job name.

methods.name: shouldReturnApplyChargeToOverdueLoanStepConfigByJobCategory
methods.description: Tests retrieval of available business steps by job category, verifying the presence of specific steps.

methods.name: shouldUpdateStepOrder
methods.description: Tests updating the order of business steps in a job configuration and verifies the updated order.

methods.name: shouldThrowErrorWhenABusinessStepDoesNotBelongToTheGivenJob
methods.description: Verifies that the API returns an error when attempting to update steps that do not belong to the specified job.

methods.name: shouldThrowErrorWhenBusinessStepListIsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that the API returns an error when attempting to set an empty list of business steps for a job.

methods.name: getBusinessSteps
methods.description: Helper method to create a BusinessStep object with specified order and step name.
